decisions.reason: The check-in app was featured on the home page as part of the firm's announced innovation drive, and its weak results can still be blamed on the temporary pandemic collapse of air travel, so management would keep it as aviation recovers in 2022, although a single app represents a smaller investment than the hardware line.

PassBoard was publicly launched as a multi-model product line from in-house technology development and is central to the firm's claim to lead the high-end market, so dropping it would write off a large visible investment while poor 2020-2021 results are easily attributed to COVID.

The self-service check-in solution was showcased publicly and fits the post-pandemic demand for contactless processing, so management would justify persisting with it and treat the slump as a temporary, pandemic-driven disruption.
